Both in-process sealed retained admissions resolve current active snapshot/selected principal/lease/controller PIDFD and full source closure. No caller dict or admission kind chosen by worker.
restart: Root memory restart is finite stop then new start, each independent fresh grant under same actual lifecycle admission/current restart quota/original deadline. Never reuse start grant or infer ready from status.

Target/capability from exact protected operation rule/target, never generic bootstrap capability.
signing: Existing current authority key/signer signs each canonical UTF8 sorted compact JSON record excluding signature with separate domain prefixes root-selected-service-context-v1 and root-selected-service-effect-v1. context_sha256 hashes exact signed canonical context bytes. Nonces independent cryptographic32-byte hex; lease<=30s and actual admission/controller/service original deadlines. Full source closure retained behind root admission and revalidated; hash alone never reconstructs provenance.
consume_API: AuthorityService.consume_root_selected_service_effect(grant,admission,selected_profile,canonical_payload_bytes)->VerifiedRootSelectedServiceEffect root-private sealed object. Verify signature/domain/epoch/current policy/selected profile UID/GID/generation/source/consent/current live controller PIDFD, exact full canonical request SHA, role/action/target/capability and expiry; atomic pending->consumed nonce once before effect. custody_API: ManagedProcessEffectHandler.perform_root_selected_service_effect(selected_profile,verified_effect,canonical_payload_bytes,*,timeout,cancelled)->existing typed managed start/status/stop receipt. Requires actual sealed verification object and immediately rechecks selected enrollment, controller currentness and original deadline before kernel operation. startup_projection: RootSelectedStartupGrant wraps this distinct context/authorization and actual startup admission. Earlier v65 requirement of ordinary service-UID HostContext/EffectAuthorization is superseded; no inherited setup PID relabelled selected worker identity. RootSelectedDisplayStarter calls issue->consume->custody for each exact role separately; signed current network/Xauthority/start receipts remain required.
memory_projection: RootMemoryServiceLifecycle uses same issuer/consumer/custody mechanism with nested lifecycle_binding exact start operation/empty schema/readiness/prestart receipts. Root actual consent/profile/owner/service generation bound, status/stop root-resolve only process it launched. Memory configured runtime/engine/source/health facts still mandatory; unknown/liveness cannot become usable memory.
evidence: Actual controller vs selected subject separation and kernel launch; forged/foreign controller, changed source/consent/profile/UID/generation/target/bytes/domain/expiry/replay negatives; worker ordinary context route cannot invoke root-selected type; each role/restart fresh grant and actual readiness distinct.
